s05CD76.name: Course clear state 1: draw bonus star line
summary: Course clear tally, state [$13D9] = 1. If there are bonus stars ([$1900] != 0), waits for the delay in [$1424], then appends a stripe
image 'BONUS star x NN' to the buffer at $7F:837D with the star count (BCD, big digits, no leading zero) from [$1900].
When the [$13D6] timer runs out: [$1424] = [$1900], advances to state 2 and plays sound effect $11.

s05CDE9.name: Table: decimal place values
summary: 32-bit entries 10000, 1000, 100, 10, 1 (little endian). The high word of each entry is read from the 4 bytes before it, so $0000 is read from here.

s05CDFD.name: Convert number to decimal tiles
summary: Writes the decimal digits of the 32-bit value in [$00]-[$03] ([$00] = high word, [$02] = low word) as five tile numbers into the
stripe image buffer, by repeated subtraction of the place values. The tile attribute byte (high byte of each word) is kept.
Parameters: X: byte offset from $7F:837B of the first tile word. Y: 0 to start at the 10000s digit.
Returns: X advanced by 10; [$00]-[$03] hold the remainder.

s05CE3A.name: Tables: time digit values
summary: DATA_05CE3A: word values 0, 100, 200, 300 for the hundreds digit of the timer. DATA_05CE42: byte values 0, 10, ..., 90 for the tens digit.

s05CE4C.name: Compute time bonus (timer x 50)
summary: Converts the timer digits [$0F31] (hundreds), [$0F32] (tens), [$0F33] (ones) to a number, multiplies it by 50 with the hardware
multiplier and returns the product.
Returns: [$02]-[$03] = timer * 50 (16-bit).

s05CEA3.name: Stripe image template: time bonus and stars
summary: Template copied to the stripe buffer each frame of state 2: VRAM $51B1 five tiles (time bonus number), $51F3 two tiles (top
of the bonus star digits), $5213 two tiles (bottom of the digits), then the $FF end marker. The digits are patched in afterwards.

s05CEC2.name: Tables: tally step sizes and score increments
summary: DATA_05CEC2: amount subtracted from the bonus points per frame (10 or 100). DATA_05CEC6: amount added to the score (1 or 10; probably in units of 10 points).

s05CECA.name: Course clear state 2: count up bonus tally
summary: Runs once per frame. Moves the remaining time bonus [$0F40] into the current player's score ($0F34/$0F36, X = 0 or 3) by 10 or 100
per frame, and every 4th frame moves one bonus star from [$1900] (BCD countdown) into the player's total [$0F48 + player].
Rebuilds the stripe image from the template each frame with the current number and star digits (leading zeros blanked).
When both reach 0: [$13D6] = $30 (delay), next state, sound effect $12.

s05CFEA.name: Table: 16x16 tile definitions (probably)
summary: The first 22 bytes are $FF padding; the table proper starts at $05D000. Each entry is 8 bytes: four (tile, properties) word pairs
for the four 8x8 tiles of a 16x16 block (property bytes look like SNES tilemap attributes with flips). Probably the overworld Map16 table;
nothing here references it by label.

s05D608.name: Table: per-translevel value for [$1DEA]
summary: Indexed by the translevel number [$13BF]; the result is stored to [$1DEA] while a level loads (probably the matching overworld location).
$FF entries are levels without one. Ends with $FF padding.

s05D708.name: Tables: initial layer Y positions, scroll type
summary: DATA_05D708: initial layer 1 Y position ([$1C]), indexed by bits 2-3 of level header byte 2 (DATA_05F400).
DATA_05D70C: initial layer 2 Y position ([$20]), indexed by bits 0-1 of the same byte.
DATA_05D710: stored to [$1414] (probably layer 2 vertical scroll type), indexed by the top nibble of DATA_05F000 for the level.

s05D720.name: Table: layer 2 scroll type A
summary: Stored to [$1413] (probably layer 2 horizontal scroll type), indexed like DATA_05D710 by the top nibble of DATA_05F000.

s05D730.name: Table: Mario start Y position (low)
summary: Mario's initial Y position low byte (RAM_MarioYPos), indexed by the low nibble of DATA_05F000 for the level.

s05D740.name: Table: Mario start Y position (high)
summary: Mario's initial Y position high byte (RAM_MarioYPosHi), same index as DATA_05D730.

s05D750.name: Table: Mario start X position (low)
summary: Mario's initial X position low byte (RAM_MarioXPos), indexed by bits 0-2 of DATA_05F200. DATA_05D758 holds the matching high bytes.
DATA_05D760 (last row): level tileset numbers 5,1,2,6,8,1 compared with the level header; the match index picks the pointers below.

PtrsLong05D766.name: Pointers: special level layer 1 data
summary: Six 24-bit pointers to layer 1 level data in bank 07, indexed by X*3 (X from the DATA_05D760 match). Copied to [$65]-[$67]
for the built-in special levels (the matching layer 2 pointers are in the table that follows).
